definitions.explanation: Any device or structure used to block sunlight, such as an awning, parasol, shade cloth, or sun visor. Used for both architectural elements and portable shade devices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{日除|ひよ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けた→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I installed a sun blind on the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦テラス→テラス：28798_terasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{日除|ひよ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テント→テント：03859_tento⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a shade tent on the terrace.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏場|なつば}→夏場：28060_natsuba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日除|ひよ}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かなり→かなり：01149_kanari⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: In summer, the room temperature rises considerably without a sunshade.

notes:
{日除|ひよ}け comes from ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (sun) + {除|よ}ける (to ward off). Also written as {日避|ひよ}け. It covers any device or structure that blocks sunlight, from architectural awnings to portable parasols.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日除|ひよ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧: to put up a sunshade
- {日除|ひよ}け⟦テント→テント：03859_tento⟧: shade tent
- {日除|ひよ}け⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧: sun hat
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日除|ひよ}け: car sun visor/shade

RELATED ～{除|よ}け WORDS:
- {雨除|あまよ}け: rain shelter
- {風除|かぜよ}け: windbreak
- ⟦{虫除|むしよ}け→虫除け：09715_mushiyoke⟧: insect repellent
- ⟦{魔除|まよ}け→魔除け：20337_mayoke⟧: charm against evil

The ～{除|よ}け pattern is productive and means "protection from" or "warding off" whatever the first element names.
